cbc_max: every process ends in pc = DONE or CRASH (Termination property in spec); terminating algorithm. NOTE: with -deadlock TLC reaches a reachable state where MAX's CHOOSE fails (corpus finding, see DRAFT_ITERATION.md)
EWD840_proof: termination-detection ring reaches quiescent state once termination is detected; deadlock expected

HDiskSynod: Ballot(_)/IsMajority(_) are operator constants, no in-module substitution possible via cfg alone; MC_HDiskSynod (vendored from tla-examples/specifications/diskpaxos/) supplies BallotImpl/IsMajorityImpl and the HInit/HNext/HInv1-4,6 checkable predicates.
Queens: solver terminates when todo = {} (Termination property in spec); terminating algorithm
SpanTreeTest: spanning-tree computation converges to a fixpoint with no enabled actions; terminating algorithm
TLCMC: StateGraph is a record-valued constant, not expressible in cfg syntax; TestGraphs (vendored from tla-examples/specifications/TLC/) unqualified-INSTANCEs TLCMC with a concrete graph (G7/V7).

HanoiSeq: A/B/C are sequence-valued CONSTANTS, no cfg tuple syntax; hand-authored wrapper (no upstream MC wrapper found) supplies them as zero-arity operator overrides per the modules own worked example.
KnuthYao: Next requires state \notin Done; die roll terminates in an absorbing state by design
